titlePlain: Finding and Fixing a Join Fanout That
subtitle: Video 16 of 20 · Brightleaf Fitness

eyebrow: The bug: one invoice, joined against every day
code:
-- revenue_mart (BEFORE)
from billing b
inner join active_members a
    on a.member_id = b.member_id
   and a.activity_date
       between b.billing_period_start
           and b.billing_period_end
-- active_members: one row per member per DAY
caption: One $49 invoice matches ~30 day-rows before the SUM ever runs.

eyebrow: Proof it's a grain mismatch, not dirty data
code:
billing_id   period_length_days   matched_rows
B-55210       30                    30
B-61094        31                    31
B-50218         28                    28
caption: matched_rows tracks the calendar exactly -- the signature of a grain bug.

eyebrow: The fix: join at the right grain
code:
-- revenue_mart (AFTER)
inner join member_activity_mart mm
    on mm.member_id = b.member_id
   and mm.activity_month =
       date_trunc('month', b.billing_period_start)
-- one invoice -> exactly one matched row
caption: $37,966,830 drops to $1,285,340 -- matching the hand-summed total exactly.

subtitle: Proving it, formally, before calling it done.
